TIER_1_PUBLIC_BENCHMARK.barrier: Minimal opacity. Audited Form 10-K, IFRS, or local exchange filings exist.
TIER_1_PUBLIC_BENCHMARK.proxy_strategy: Direct registry extraction (SEC EDGAR, BVB, LSE). Used to calibrate proxy error baselines.
TIER_1_PUBLIC_BENCHMARK.commercial_risk: Low entity ambiguity, but high risk of contract stagnation if historical seat pricing fails to track annual turnover growth.

TIER_2_TAX_TRANSFER_DISTORTION.tier: Tier 2: Structural Distortions (Tax & Transfer Pricing Hubs)
TIER_2_TAX_TRANSFER_DISTORTION.archetype: Foreign Operating & Billing Hubs vs Manufacturing Plants
TIER_2_TAX_TRANSFER_DISTORTION.barrier: Entity revenue is decoupled from local physical footprint. Brass-plate billing hubs show astronomical booked revenue; local assembly plants show massive headcount with low margins.
TIER_2_TAX_TRANSFER_DISTORTION.proxy_strategy: Headcount-to-revenue divergence analysis. Cross-referencing local CRO/ONRC registry filings with LinkedIn and physical site counts.
TIER_2_TAX_TRANSFER_DISTORTION.commercial_risk: Severe mispricing. Pricing on revenue overcharges billing hubs (5k staff booking €80B); pricing on headcount under-bills global software consumption.

TIER_3_REGULATORY_EXEMPTION.barrier: Statutory filing exemptions (UK Companies Act micro-entity rules, German §264a HGB for KG/UG). Balance sheets are abbreviated; Profit & Loss (turnover) is legally withheld.
TIER_3_REGULATORY_EXEMPTION.proxy_strategy: Unit-economics & physical footprint proxies: daily transactions, oven/table capacity, storefront locations, guild/chamber registrations.
TIER_3_REGULATORY_EXEMPTION.commercial_risk: Overcharging & customer churn. Automated models applying industry-average revenues overbill 6-person local workshops.

TIER_4_STRATEGIC_SECRECY.tier: Tier 4: Strategic Secrecy (Private Conglomerates & Family Trusts)
TIER_4_STRATEGIC_SECRECY.barrier: Privately owned by foundations (e.g. Hans Wilsdorf) or private LLCs with no public stock filings.
TIER_4_STRATEGIC_SECRECY.proxy_strategy: Physical capacity & output proxies: production unit certifications (COSC watch movements), container fleet TEU capacity, logistics warehouse sqft.
TIER_4_STRATEGIC_SECRECY.commercial_risk: Massive revenue leakage. Multi-billion luxury or shipping giants paying standard private-company enterprise fees.

TIER_5_VELOCITY_DISTORTION.tier: Tier 5: High Velocity (Hyper-Growth AI & Venture Startups)
TIER_5_VELOCITY_DISTORTION.archetype: VC-Backed DeepTech, Defense Tech & AI Startups
TIER_5_VELOCITY_DISTORTION.barrier: Historic corporate filings (if any) are obsolete in 90 days. Headcount is lean (20-100 staff), but ARR scales exponentially from $0 to $100M+.
TIER_5_VELOCITY_DISTORTION.proxy_strategy: Venture round valuation multiples, developer adoption velocity, GitHub traction, and enterprise seat deployment tracking.
TIER_5_VELOCITY_DISTORTION.commercial_risk: Severe under-pricing. Vendor charges small-team tier ($5k/yr) while client raises billions and deploys product to thousands of end-users.

TIER_6_CAPITAL_VS_OPERATIONS.tier: Tier 6: Capital vs. Operations Illusion (Three People & a Mailbox)
TIER_6_CAPITAL_VS_OPERATIONS.archetype: Holding Vehicles, Wealth Management SPFs & Shells
TIER_6_CAPITAL_VS_OPERATIONS.barrier: Société de Gestion de Patrimoine Familial (Luxembourg SPF) or pure asset holding vehicles. Balance sheet assets exceed hundreds of millions, but commercial revenue and operating staff are near zero.
TIER_6_CAPITAL_VS_OPERATIONS.proxy_strategy: Statutory legal form identification (SPF, SICAV, Vermögensverwaltung). Discarding balance sheet equity as an operating proxy.
TIER_6_CAPITAL_VS_OPERATIONS.commercial_risk: Lost negotiations. Vendor attempts enterprise pricing on balance sheet scale to an entity requiring only 2 administrative licenses.

TIER_7_LEGAL_GHOSTS_DEFUNCT.archetype: Product Brands, Bankrupt Estates & M&A Carve-Outs
TIER_7_LEGAL_GHOSTS_DEFUNCT.barrier: The entity on the contract is either a marketing trade brand (no legal entity), an insolvent estate, or an entity dissolved through emergency acquisition.
TIER_7_LEGAL_GHOSTS_DEFUNCT.proxy_strategy: Registry status verification (Amtsgericht insolvency decrees, commercial register dissolution, parent brand attribution rules).
TIER_7_LEGAL_GHOSTS_DEFUNCT.commercial_risk: Legal unenforceability & bad debt write-offs. Software runs for defunct or dissolved entities where licenses cannot be legally recovered.

TIER_8_POLYSEMIC_AMBIGUITY.barrier: Generic corporate names (e.g. 'Apex Group', 'Meridian') with missing geographic and digital breadcrumbs.
TIER_8_POLYSEMIC_AMBIGUITY.proxy_strategy: Resolution Threshold Rule: explicitly categorizing as 'Unresolvable: Insufficient Disambiguation Signals' to prevent false-positive matching.
TIER_8_POLYSEMIC_AMBIGUITY.commercial_risk: Catastrophic misattribution. Conflating a local shipping agency with a multi-billion dollar hedge fund.

TIER_9_PUBLIC_SECTOR_UTILITIES.archetype: Public Health Trusts, Municipal Utilities & Authorities
TIER_9_PUBLIC_SECTOR_UTILITIES.barrier: Non-commercial accounting. Revenue corresponds to tax appropriations, farebox tariffs, or statutory grants, not competitive market sales.
TIER_9_PUBLIC_SECTOR_UTILITIES.proxy_strategy: Public budget allocations, hospital bed count, passenger volume, municipal operating reports.
TIER_9_PUBLIC_SECTOR_UTILITIES.commercial_risk: Budget freeze / procurement failure. Public sector compliance requires bespoke licensing independent of commercial ARR models.

TIER_10_SPINOFFS_MAZE.barrier: Independent public listing while retaining parent naming heritage (e.g. Siemens Healthineers, Siemens Energy).
TIER_10_SPINOFFS_MAZE.proxy_strategy: Ownership stake & consolidation test: verify parent 10-K consolidation (>50% vs deconsolidated public spin-offs).
TIER_10_SPINOFFS_MAZE.commercial_risk: Contract arbitrage. Spun-off multi-billion standalone entities sharing licenses under parent conglomerate umbrella discounts.
